messages:
clare: Quick flag  telemetry+console want a deterministic grouping key on notify events so SLO tiles don't fragment during spikes. Current free-form "rule_name" isn't cutting it. Who owns the contract here? cc @ben

ben: Platform owns the notify surface but we need a concrete list of fields. What are telemetry/console asking for?

rachel: Minimal: stable_key (string), source_hint, and window_seconds. stable_key must be a stable identifier that survives evaluator restarts (eg 'slo:org-7:err_rate:5m').

zach: Add evaluator_effective_threshold too. Console shows the configured threshold but not the resolved one after inheritance; that confuses customers.

clare: Also want a small event_type enum: ["slo_violation","sample","anomaly"]. "sample" events should be non-actionable by default.

ben: Backcompat: plan is opt-in header `X-Notify-Version: 2`. New fields optional initially. Telemetry will run a fallback hash if stable_key missing during shadow-run.

rachel: For SDKs we should expose a helper to build stable_key. For legacy integrations, the computed fallback needs an "inferred" badge in the UI so it's clear grouping is best-effort.

zach: Operationally: sampled events (event_type=="sample") should not page. If same stable_key later emits slo_violation, it must page. We'll add that to the runbook.

ingest-bot: rollout-plan: notify-api v2 shadow-run window scheduled 2024-06-15 03:00 UTC (epoch 1719912000). Will log clients missing v2 headers.

clare: One more ask: include pipeline_latency_ms and ingestion_region so SRE can triage noisy bursts.

ben: Agreed. Example minimal v2 payload: ```{ "org_id":"org-7", "stable_key":"slo:org-7:latency:p95:5m", "event_type":"slo_violation", "ts":1723459900, "evaluator_effective_threshold":"300ms" }```

rachel: Also include a small `ttl_seconds` on the event so Console knows how long to keep the grouped tile active before collapsing.

zach: During shadow-run telemetry should emit `grouping_match_rate` per-tenant daily. We should pick a few tenants (small/med/large) for early validation. Goal: >90% match between current grouping and v2 grouping before opt-in flip.

clare: UX: add tenant-level opt-in toggle "Enable stable grouping (preview)" so customers can verify grouping before switch. Console should show examples of grouped vs inferred when toggled.

ben: I'll open the API PR and include schema, examples, migration checklist, and SDK helper. I'll also add the header `X-Notify-Version` behavior in docs.

rachel: Runbook edits: SRE to handle dedupe regressions and noisy-match alerts. Document: `if grouping_match_rate drops >10% during shadow-run, pause rollout and investigate`

zach: Sync proposal: quick lock meeting tomorrow 09:30 UTC with SDKs, Telemetry, Console, SRE. Agenda: required fields, header semantics, shadow metrics to collect (grouping_match_rate, sample_rate, inferred_pct), opt-in UX, runbook paging rules.

clare: Thanks all 64f: I'll add agenda and sample tenant list to the calendar invite.
